text.text: Every Stigma bears a burden; the more exalted the material, the less readily its form is borne. A tool's own materials provide capacity, while Tuning within the Crown quiets what exceeds that capacity.

When burden passes beyond capacity and Tuning, the Stigmata cease to rest within the tool's intent. At first they leave only slight deviations in their working. As overload deepens, they forget foe and bearer, weight and purpose. In the end, the wielder is merely another possible object of their choosing.
The gifts of the Stigmata do not vanish. They merely begin to manifest in their own fashion.
